title: Prune redundant instance states and rename token-axis for charts & tables
creator: Maya Chen
description: Background: Over the last 18 months the Figma library has accumulated many near-duplicate button/table/chart instances and token axes (spacing-density, color-surface variants). This has increased designer friction, led to accidental regressions during publish, and added churn to downstream handoffs. Goal: Remove redundant instance/state permutations while keeping semantic state coverage (default, hover, pressed, disabled, selected), and rename token axis keys to a consistent, human-readable taxonomy. Deliver a cleaned Figma library that passes the publish checklist and has migration guidance for teams.
acceptance_criteria: All button and table component families reduced to <= 3 density variants with clear naming conventions (Compact, Default, Spacious)
Chart primitives exposed as single-source tokens for color, axis-padding, and grid-density; legacy 'density-*' tokens consolidated to 'density.compact|density.default|density.spacious'
No duplicate instances with identical overrides remain in the published library file
Auto-layout frame constraints normalized for header/row cells so switches between density variants do not require manual correction
Figma publish passes automated lint checklist and Design Ops signs off on release notes
Migration guide published to Confluence with a QA checklist and two example PRs showing fixups for product repos
tasks: Inventory: run instance-scan on library and export CSV of duplicates (owner: Ari)
Token rename plan: propose mapping table from old keys -> new keys (owner: Maya)
Create canary file with consolidated components and run internal pilot with Platform team (owner: Jesse)
Author Figma plugin script to bulk-repoint instances to canonical components where safe (owner: Eng/Tooling)
Update publish gating: require no unresolved overrides and normalized auto-layout constraints (owner: Design Ops)
Write Confluence migration guide and communication plan for cross-functional teams (owner: PM)
Schedule review and sign-off session with Accessibility and Design QA (owner: Maya)
Tag and merge final published library and announce in #design-release (owner: Ari)
design_notes: Keep semantic tokens (e.g., color.surface-strong) separate from density axes to avoid combinatorial explosion
Prefer explicit naming over numeric suffixes — example: 'button/primary/compact' instead of 'btn-primary-32'
Where an instance's overrides are >3 properties, convert to a separate component variant instead of ad-hoc overrides
Charts: move grid and axis spacing into tokens so charts can adapt to density via token swaps rather than instance edits
Avoid renaming tokens in-place for files that are already consumed by Customer Success without a migration window; provide alias tokens for a deprecation period
